messages.text: Morning. Implied moves on the semis prints this week are getting stupid. Straddles pricing like 9% on names that averaged 5 last year.
Yeah, vol bid into the print and crushed after. Selling it has been working but one gap against you and it's ugly.
Heads up, OMS is a little laggy on the open, acks taking 2-3 sec. Anyone else seeing it?
Seeing it too on algo child orders. Slicing wider on the VWAPs until it clears. I'll ping tech if it's still slow at 9:45.
Reminder: three names on the restricted list report after the close today. Check before you touch anything in those.
Agreed. I'm sizing down into prints, half normal. Not paying up for gamma at these levels.
Retail names are gapping at the open again, spreads 3x normal on the first 10 minutes. Working passive until it settles.
Same. Pulled back participation to 8% on the thin ones, volume curve is front-loaded today anyway.
OMS acks back to normal now. Thanks Travis.
TradeBlotter P&L looks off on my book, still showing yesterday's close marks for a couple of the post-earnings movers. Refresh not helping.
Probably a stale price on those. Check the last tick vs the screen before you trust the number.
Tape's quiet into lunch. Positioning for after the bell prints, anyone want to share color on the guide-down chatter?
Buy side is lightening ahead of the numbers, saw a lot of two-way flow but net sell. I'd stay light until we see the reaction.
